A whimsical parade of beloved animals—elephant, giraffe, zebra, lion, and bear—celebrate together in a sun-dappled meadow bursting with wildflowers and soft pastel balloons.

This enchanting mural captures pure joy and wonder, perfect for inspiring imagination and curiosity in young hearts.

products.title: Treehouse Enchantment
products.description:
A whimsical mural depicting an enchanted forest village nestled among ancient trees, where charming pastel cottages perch on branches connected by delicate rope bridges and winding staircases.

Soft watercolor washes blend blooming flowers, rolling streams, and golden sunlight to create a serene, storybook atmosphere perfect for sparking imagination.

products.title: Steam Valley Reverie
products.description:
A whimsical vintage landscape where a charming steam locomotive winds through rolling pastoral hills, crossing elegant stone arches over tranquil waterways. Soft florals, cypress trees, and a distant windmill create a dreamy, nostalgic journey through an idealized European countryside.

Perfect for spaces that celebrate travel, heritage, and the romance of bygone eras.

products.title: Melody Garden
products.description:
A whimsical landscape where music blooms into nature. Oversized paintbrushes and drums rise like sculptures amid rolling hills of soft pastels, while musical notes drift through the air like birds, and delicate flowers punctuate the composition.

Perfect for inspiring creativity and joy in spaces designed for imagination and artistic expression.

products.title: Deep Ocean Wonder
products.description:
A serene underwater tableau teeming with life, where majestic whales glide alongside playful dolphins and a golden submarine explores coral gardens in soft, dreamy watercolors.

Perfect for nurturing imagination and curiosity, this mural wraps young explorers in a world of gentle discovery and aquatic magic.

products.title: Construction Dreams
products.description: A whimsical watercolor mural celebrating the joy of building and creation. Soft pastels and playful machinery dance across a gentle landscape, where diggers, cranes, and trucks work together in harmony—perfect for inspiring young minds to imagine, create, and dream big.

products.title: Mesozoic Valley
products.description:
A sweeping panorama of prehistoric majesty, where towering dinosaurs roam lush valleys under amber-tinted skies. Rendered in soft, naturalistic watercolor tones, this mural evokes wonder and timeless adventure.

Perfect for sparking imagination and creating a gateway to ancient worlds.

products.title: Village Reverie
products.description: A whimsical illustrated countryside village rendered in soft pastels, brimming with charming architecture, blooming trees, and gentle activity. This mural captures the serene magic of a storybook town, perfect for creating a dreamy, peaceful sanctuary.

products.title: Misty Valley
products.description:
A serene watercolor landscape capturing rolling mountains shrouded in soft mist and gentle fog, with a tranquil river winding through verdant valleys below. Delicate coniferous trees dot the slopes in muted greens and greys, evoking a sense of timeless natural beauty and peaceful solitude.

This premium mural brings understated elegance and calming atmosphere to any interior, perfect for those seeking a connection to nature's quiet majesty.

products.title: Coastal Dunes
products.description:
A serene watercolor vista of windswept dunes and native grasses framing a tranquil bay dotted with distant sailboats. Soft, muted tones of sand, sage, and pale blue create an effortlessly elegant coastal atmosphere.

Perfect for spaces seeking understated, naturalistic beauty with sophisticated restraint.

products.title: Willow Meadow
products.description:
A serene botanical mural featuring delicate willow branches cascading above a meadow of wildflowers, interspersed with soft birds and butterflies. The watercolor palette of soft greens, peaches, and grays creates an airy, contemplative atmosphere.

Perfect for spaces seeking nature-inspired tranquility and understated elegance.

products.title: Dreamhill Reverie
products.description:
A whimsical landscape mural that celebrates rolling pastel hills, gentle rainbows, and a serene sky populated with soft clouds and warm sunlight. Each undulating terrain is delicately rendered in blush, sage, and cream tones, creating depth and movement across the wall.

Perfect for spaces that crave tranquility and wonder, this design brings an ethereal, storybook quality to any room, inviting calm contemplation and joyful imagination.

products.title: Celestial Whispers
products.description:
A dreamy nursery wallpaper that captures the magic of day and night in soft, watercolour strokes. Delicate rainbows, gentle clouds, playful shooting stars, and sleepy moons float across a warm cream canvas, creating a serene sanctuary for little ones.

Perfect for sparking imagination and wonder while maintaining a calm, restful atmosphere.

products.title: Balloon Dreams
products.description:
A whimsical celebration of soft pastels and delicate florals, this design floats gently across the wall with oversized balloons in blush, cream, and powder blue, interspersed with hand-painted botanical sprigs and tiny stars.

Perfect for creating a serene, dreamlike atmosphere that feels both tender and playful, this mural brings joy and wonder to any young child's sanctuary.

products.title: Paper Boats at Dusk
products.description: A whimsical watercolor journey of delicate paper boats sailing across a serene sunset sea. Soft pastels and gentle starlight create a dreamy, tender atmosphere perfect for nurturing imagination and wonder.

products.title: Pastel Dream Sky
products.description: A serene watercolor composition featuring soft clouds, a gentle rainbow arc, and a warm sun suspended in a dreamy pastel palette. Delicate raindrops and scattered stars create a whimsical, peaceful mood perfect for spaces that celebrate calm beauty and wonder.

products.title: Sky Wanderers
products.description:
Soft hot air balloons drift serenely across an impressionistic landscape of rolling hills and misty mountains, rendered in delicate pastels and watercolor washes.

A dreamy, whimsical mural that captures the magic of flight and adventure in a warm, nostalgic palette perfect for inspiring young imaginations.

products.title: Kite Dreams
products.description:
Whimsical kites dance gracefully across a soft, dreamy sky in this enchanting mural design. Rendered in gentle pastels of blush, cream, and dusty blue, the composition captures the pure joy and freedom of childhood wonder.

Perfect for creating a serene, playful atmosphere in any young person's sanctuary.

products.title: Celestial Meadow
products.description:
A dreamy constellation of delicate wildflowers and botanical sprays anchors this ethereal mural, while soft watercolour planets, moons, and stars drift gently overhead in warm pastels.

Perfect for creating a serene, imaginative sanctuary that feels both whimsical and calming—ideal for nurturing spaces that inspire wonder and rest.

products.title: Swallow Song
products.description:
Graceful swallows dance among delicate flowering branches in this enchanting botanical mural. Rendered in soft watercolor tones of slate blue and cream, the design captures a sense of peaceful movement and natural elegance.

Perfect for creating a serene, sophisticated atmosphere in any space.

products.title: Watercolor Botanica
products.description:
A dreamy composition of soft watercolor leaves, seed heads, and abstract circular forms in muted sage, pale blue, and warm cream tones. Each element floats with gentle transparency, creating layers of botanical elegance.

Perfect for spaces seeking understated sophistication and natural calm, this design brings a gallery-like refinement to any interior.

products.title: Seashore Whisper
products.description:
A delicate underwater garden unfolds across soft cream, where graceful seahorses, gentle seaweed, and weathered shells dance among wispy aquatic flora.

Rendered in muted blues, sage greens, and warm sand tones, this design evokes the serene beauty of tidal pools and coastal calm.

products.title: Pastel Sky Dreams
products.description: Soft, hand-drawn rainbows float gently across a cream canvas, accented with delicate stars in warm pastels—pink, peach, yellow, and blue. This whimsical design creates an airy, dreamy atmosphere perfect for spaces that celebrate wonder and joy.

products.title: Dawn Meadow
products.description: A serene pastoral landscape where delicate wildflowers and grasses stretch beneath a luminous rising sun, framed by soft rainbow arches. Watercolour washes in pastel tones create an ethereal, tranquil mood perfect for spaces seeking gentle warmth and natural beauty.

products.title: Deer Pavilion Garden
products.description: A serene Mughal-inspired landscape where graceful deer graze beneath blooming trees within an ornate garden sanctuary. Soft watercolor washes in cream, sage, and blush tones create a dreamy, timeless atmosphere—perfect for spaces seeking refined tranquility.

products.title: Forest Meadow
products.description:
A serene woodland scene featuring delicate woodland creatures—fox, hare, hedgehog, and young deer—gracefully wandering through a soft, botanical meadow. Rendered in warm earth tones and gentle pastels, this mural evokes a timeless storybook quality.

Perfect for creating a calm, nature-inspired sanctuary that appeals to both children and discerning adults who cherish organic beauty and vintage-inspired illustration.

products.title: Olive Pastoral
products.description:
A serene landscape mural depicting rolling hills dotted with ancient olive groves and grazing livestock under a soft, hazy sky.

This watercolor-inspired design evokes the timeless beauty of Mediterranean countryside, rendered in warm, muted earth tones and gentle pastels.

Perfect for creating a peaceful, grounded atmosphere that feels both intimate and expansive.

products.title: Serengeti Reverie
products.description:
A soft, watercolour landscape capturing the timeless beauty of African wildlife in their natural habitat. Giraffes, elephants, and acacia trees emerge from muted earth tones and gentle clouds, evoking tranquility and wonder.

Perfect for spaces seeking warmth, heritage, and a connection to the natural world.

products.title: Alpine Sentries
products.description:
A serene watercolor landscape capturing two watchful prairie dogs amid wildflower meadows, with rolling mountains and evergreen forests in soft, muted tones.

This gentle mural evokes the quiet majesty of untamed valleys, blending botanical charm with peaceful wildlife moments for spaces seeking natural elegance and earthy tranquility.

products.title: Prehistoric Valley
products.description: A sweeping landscape mural capturing an ancient world of misty mountains, lush palms, and wandering dinosaurs in soft, muted tones. This vintage-inspired vista evokes wonder and timeless discovery, perfect for sparking imagination.

products.title: Amer Reverie
products.description:
An ethereal vision of Mughal splendour rendered in soft, luminous watercolour tones. Delicate flowering vines frame ornate pavilions and domed monuments, while graceful peacocks inhabit gardens of white blooms and verdant cypress.

This dreamy mural evokes timeless heritage and romantic nostalgia, perfect for creating an atmosphere of serene elegance.

products.title: Iris Lagoon
products.description:
A serene watercolor meditation on nature's quiet beauty, this mural captures graceful swans gliding through iris-bordered waters scattered with lily pads. Soft blues, lavenders, and sage greens blend seamlessly to create a timeless landscape that feels both dreamy and grounded.

Perfect for spaces seeking tranquility and understated elegance.

products.title: Magnolia Whisper
products.description:
Delicate magnolia blossoms drift across soft, neutral tones in this serene botanical composition. Watercolor branches adorned with pale pink and cream flowers create an atmosphere of understated elegance and natural grace.

Perfect for cultivating a calm, sophisticated sanctuary that feels both timeless and contemporary.

products.title: Floating Horizons
products.description: A dreamy landscape mural capturing the gentle ascent of hot air balloons over rolling hills and classical architecture. Soft watercolor tones of cream, blush, and sage create a timeless, romantic atmosphere that evokes wanderlust and serenity. Perfect for spaces that celebrate both natural beauty and the spirit of adventure.

products.title: Orchard Reverie
products.description:
A dreamy pastoral landscape where abundant fruit trees frame a rolling countryside dotted with wildflowers and distant villages. Rendered in soft watercolour tones, this mural evokes the timeless charm of European countryside estates and heritage gardens.

Perfect for creating a serene, romantic atmosphere that celebrates nature's abundance and pastoral beauty.

products.title: Willow Reflection
products.description:
A serene East Asian-inspired landscape rendered in delicate watercolor tones, featuring a graceful weeping willow draped over tranquil waters. A gentle arched bridge, distant mountains, and wading birds create a contemplative scene of timeless elegance.

Perfect for creating a calm, introspective sanctuary with soft pastels and romantic brushwork.

products.title: Vintage Sky Expedition
products.description: A dreamy watercolor mural capturing the golden age of aviation, with delicate biplanes soaring through soft, cloud-dappled skies above a patchwork countryside. The warm, muted palette and gentle brushwork evoke nostalgia and wanderlust, perfect for spaces that celebrate adventure and timeless elegance.

products.title: Celestial Blossom II
products.description:
An enchanting ceiling mural that transforms any room into a romantic garden sanctuary. Delicate flowering vines frame an open sky where graceful birds dance among soft clouds, creating a sense of boundless elegance and timeless beauty.

Perfect for creating a premium, sophisticated atmosphere with botanical charm and whimsical movement.

products.title: Celestial Aviary
products.description:
An enchanting circular mural featuring ornate botanical details and exotic birds rendered in soft pastels and warm earth tones. Delicate florals intertwine with vibrant parrots and songbirds, all radiating from an ornamental sun medallion at the center.

This premium design evokes classical European elegance with an exotic twist, perfect for creating a sophisticated focal point in any room.

products.title: Peacock Palace Garden
products.description:
An enchanting tableau of majestic peacocks amid blooming gardens, framed by a stately palatial backdrop. Delicate florals and verdant foliage create a serene, timeless sanctuary that whispers of royal elegance.

Perfect for creating a sophisticated, nature-inspired ambiance in any discerning space.

products.title: Elephant's Orchard
products.description:
A timeless tableau of majesty and abundance, featuring an ornately adorned elephant beside a flourishing fruit tree laden with ruby pomegranates. This hand-illustrated mural celebrates the harmony between noble creatures and nature's bounty, rendered in rich jewel tones and botanical detail.

Perfect for creating an enchanting, sophisticated atmosphere that whispers of exotic gardens and heritage craftsmanship.

products.title: Maharaja's Garden
products.description:
A majestic celebration of Indian heritage, this mural weaves together an ornately adorned elephant, vibrant florals, and graceful wildlife in a lush tapestry of deep teals, coral, and gold.

The intricate patterns and botanical richness create a sense of timeless elegance and regal sophistication.

products.title: Misty Ferns
products.description:
A serene landscape mural that frames majestic mountain vistas through delicate fern fronds and botanical flourishes. Soft, layered watercolor tones create an ethereal atmosphere, inviting calm contemplation and natural wonder into any space.

Perfect for creating a peaceful sanctuary that celebrates the quiet beauty of nature.

products.title: Hello Sunshine
products.description:
Product Code: ZY-SUN-01

Hello Sunshine is a soft, hand-painted watercolour mural of a gentle smiling sun rising over rolling pastel hills. Rainbow rays in blush, peach, buttercup and sage drift upward past little clouds, scattered stars and tiny hearts — a warm, dreamy scene made for nurseries and children's rooms.

Available to order on your choice of premium wallpaper, colour-matched and made to your exact wall measurements so the design sits perfectly edge to edge. Every mural is produced fresh for your wall — no two homes hang it quite the same.

  • Sized to your wall — priced per square foot, sized to your wall
  • Soft pastel palette, gender-neutral and calming
  • Latex inks, low-odour and child-safe
  • Free shipping across India · dispatched in 5–7 working days

products.title: Surajgati (सूरजगति)
products.description: Radiating energy and movement, Surajgati (सूरजगति) is a fiery stallion symbolizing passion, endurance, and the relentless pursuit of dreams. Its golden glow brings warmth and vitality to your surroundings.

products.title: Coral Harmony
products.description: Set against a warm coral-to-green gradient, this mural showcases vibrant long-tailed birds with shimmering green and orange plumage amidst blooming white and pink flowers. A stunning blend of bold and delicate tones, this design brings warmth and energy to living rooms or creative workspaces.

products.title: Pakshi (पक्षी)
products.description:
(Meaning “Bird” in Sanskrit, symbolizing freedom, joy, and creativity.)

This Madhubani-style wallpaper features an array of birds perched on a richly detailed tree. The colorful birds—each adorned with unique patterns—interact with blooming flowers and leaves, creating a whimsical and lively composition. The black tree trunk stands in stark contrast to the bright red, blue, and yellow elements, making this design vibrant and engaging. Perfect for children’s rooms or lively shared spaces.

products.title: Anuraag (अनुराग)
products.description:
Meaning “Love” or “Affection” in Sanskrit, symbolizing connection and harmony.

This dazzling wallpaper depicts two beautifully adorned birds resting under a vividly detailed tree. Surrounded by blooming flowers and lush greenery, the design captures the essence of Madhubani art with its rich textures and vibrant palette. The warm hues of the sunset background bring an enchanting glow, adding warmth and character to any space. Ideal for spaces seeking an intimate and culturally rich ambiance.

products.title: Mayur (मयूर)
products.description:
(Meaning “Peacock” in Sanskrit, symbolizing beauty, grace, and royalty.)

This vibrant Madhubani-style wallpaper features a majestic peacock standing amidst blooming flowers. The intricate detailing on the feathers, with eye-catching patterns in green, blue, and orange, highlights the bird’s elegance. The yellow background is adorned with flourishing trees and floral motifs, bringing a sense of festivity and natural harmony. The floral-bordered frame adds a finishing touch of richness. Ideal for spaces that radiate opulence and cultural sophistication.

products.title: Gajraj (गजराज)
products.description:
(Meaning “King of Elephants,” symbolizing strength, wisdom, and royalty.)

This regal Madhubani-style wallpaper showcases a majestic elephant adorned with intricate floral and geometric patterns. The dark blue background highlights the vibrant colors of the elephant, including bright yellows, reds, greens, and whites, representing festivity and grandeur. The border is decorated with blooming flowers, adding a touch of elegance and charm. This design is perfect for creating a bold and cultural statement in spaces like living rooms, offices, or event spaces.

products.title: Deewar (दीवार)
products.description: Deewar means wall — and this design treats the whole wall as one rhythmic composition of interlocking leaf and petal forms, wavy checkerboards and curved bands in teal, turquoise, cobalt, red, yellow, black and white. The character is bold and graphic, somewhere between mid-century collage and Indian street art. Density is high and the energy continuous, with no single focal subject — so it crops confidently to any proportion and loses nothing behind furniture. A strong choice for kids' and teen rooms, playrooms, home offices and energetic commercial spaces like cafés and studios. Premium Non-Woven keeps every edge of the geometry sharp.

products.title: Khel (खेल)
products.description: Khel means play, and the mural keeps that promise — red petal rays striped with white, teal shapes dotted like confetti, sweeping deep-green fronds with paint-drip trails, a soft peach ground and bursts of yellow, all in a joyful folk-meets-street-art style. Density is high: colour and shape fill the wall edge to edge. There is no single focal subject, so it crops generously to any wall proportion and stays lively behind desks, beds or play furniture. Made for kids' rooms, teen rooms and playful family spaces — and confident enough for a café wall. Premium Non-Woven keeps its colours bright and its edges clean.

products.title: Marbled Current
products.description:
Marbled Current — poured abstraction. No subject, no story.

Coral, marigold, cerulean and deep blue floated into one another with ribbons of black and cream, meeting in fine marbled veins rather than blending. A warm mass runs across the top, a deep blue pool opens below it, and colder aqua currents braid through the lower half.

There is no focal point, by design — which is the practical argument for it. Nothing can be cut in half, so it crops to any wall, however long or awkward, and it holds a stairwell or a playroom where a quieter pattern would simply disappear.

Listed on Amazon as: Brihaspati (बृहस्पति)

products.title: Praavah (प्रवाह)
products.description: Bold pours of crimson, teal, cobalt, chartreuse and cream collide across a pale ground in this energetic abstract, the fluid shapes flowing and pooling like poured colour caught mid-motion. Playful and fresh with high contrast, its busiest activity clusters through the upper and central area while the lower field opens into calmer cream. Keep a headboard or low console beneath the quieter base so the vivid pours stay in view above furniture. Lively enough for a kids' room, living room, foyer or creative office. It prints as one continuous mural scaled to your exact wall, never repeated. Premium Non-Woven, with its refined matte flat-colour clarity, keeps the crisp pooled edges sharp.

products.title: Rang Utsav (रंग उत्सव)
products.description: Layered washes of hot pink, magenta, coral, tangerine and chartreuse sweep across the surface with cool blue accents at the left, a celebratory blaze of colour fitting the name Rang Utsav, festival of colours. Bright and joyful, the strokes spread edge to edge with a subtle brighter cluster centre-left, yet no detail is so precise that furniture would spoil it. A headboard, sofa or console can sit anywhere against the even field. Cheerful for a kids' room, bedroom, living room or a boutique or salon. Each panel is one continuous mural scaled to your wall, not a small repeat. Soft Matte complements the soft, blended painterly layers.

products.title: Tropical Parrot Leaves
products.description: Vivid tropical parrots perch and take flight among sage banana leaves, golden pineapples and looping gold chains, all set on a clean white ground. Emerald, teal and cobalt plumage flashes with orange and yellow accents for a playful, fresh energy, and the composition is busy from edge to edge. Birds and pineapples repeat across the field, so scaling or cropping keeps lively subjects in view and furniture hides nothing crucial. It works beautifully in kids' rooms and nurseries, and adds spirit to foyers or bedrooms. Designed as one continuous mural fitted to your wall, never a small tile. Premium Non-Woven suits its crisp, graphic tropical imagery and clean white background.

products.title: Mangal (मंगल)

The fluid, marbled style carries real movement and energy, glossy and lively from edge to edge. With no fixed focal point, it crops cleanly to any proportion and forgives furniture placed anywhere across it, so a sofa or bed needs no careful alignment. Its cheerful, high-energy palette works in a kids' room, playroom, living room or a bright home office. Soft Matte complements the organic, poured character of the artwork. products.title: Tropical Birds and Flowers
products.description: A tropical reverie of jewel-toned birds — a teal-and-black perched bird above and a vivid kingfisher-like bird below — nestled among hibiscus, magnolia-like blooms and layered palms in coral-red, cream and dusty sage. products.title: Green Blossom Teal Butterflies
products.description: Muted sage green washes through this dreamy garden, where soft white hydrangea clusters and leafy stems dissolve into a misty background. Teal-and-white spotted butterflies punctuate the scene, one prominent at lower-centre, with a slender lavender sprig at the right. Gentle and playful, the density is moderate but hazy, giving a calm, nursery-friendly feel. Motifs distribute evenly so scaling to different walls keeps the composition balanced, though a low headboard is best so the central butterfly stays in view. Charming for a nursery, kids' room, or serene bedroom. A continuous mural rather than a repeating tile, its soft painterly haze suits Soft Matte.

products.title: Heron Fan Palm Garden
products.description: A serene grey pigeon perches on the lower right amid a verdant jungle, where a bright chartreuse fan palm bursts overhead and small yellow blossoms dot a still pond to the left. Detailed and gently stylised, the artwork stays almost entirely in rich greens lifted by the acid-yellow palm and warm bamboo trunks. The bird and radiant palm hold the right foreground, so on a wider wall the calmer pond and deeper forest extend leftward. Place any tall furniture on the left to keep the bird and palm crown clear. Its playful yet calm nature suits a nursery, kids' room, bedroom or living room, designed as one continuous mural. Soft Matte enhances its soft foliage detail.

products.title: Autumn Garden Tapestry
products.description: An abundant garden fills every inch here, its rounded trees shifting from deep green into orange, russet and gold and scattered with pink, white and yellow blooms; two small white rabbits rest near the centre and a terracotta pot anchors the lower edge. The style is intricate and storybook-charming, busy corner to corner with no single hotspot. Furniture can sit low anywhere, though centring a bed lets the rabbits peek above the headboard. A delightful pick for a kids' room, nursery or bedroom. Soft Matte stock suits the painterly density, and the design is composed as one continuous scene.

products.title: Enchanted Night Garden
products.description: A moonlit garden glows under a starry indigo sky, a round golden moon centred between two dark trees whose branches are dotted with amber fruit like lanterns, a pale villa tucked among the deep foliage below. Layered emerald and teal greens fill the scene, lit by orange marigolds and soft white blooms in the undergrowth, in a dreamy, decorative folk style that is dense and immersive yet calm. The moon and house sit high-centre, so scaling keeps them anchored near the top while the flowering base extends; position a low headboard or console so the moon and villa are not covered. A gentle fit for a bedroom, nursery or kids' room. Each panel prints as one continuous scene, not a repeated pattern, and the painterly finish is shown off best on Soft Matte stock.

products.title: Jungle Pond with Cranes
products.description: Two long-legged cranes stand at the edge of a still jungle pond, one wading at the water, framed by an intensely dense rainforest of ferns, palms, and a lone orange bloom. The composition is edge-to-edge and busy, worked in deep emerald, moss, and sage greens with the pale reflective water opening the lower centre. The birds anchor the foreground and the pond forms a calm focal void, so centre that waterline on the wall and keep a low headboard or bench beneath it rather than over the cranes. A continuous scene, never tiled, and being child-safe and serene it suits a nursery, kids' room, bedroom, or living room. Soft Matte complements its soft, layered painterly surface.

products.title: Flamingo Tropical Paradise
products.description: A vivid tropical paradise with slender palms arching over a calm lagoon and a faint waterfall in the misty distance, where a scarlet long-tailed parrot perches prominently at lower right and a smaller red bird rests nearby. Soft blue-greens dominate, warmed by the bird's bright red plumage, for a fresh and playful feel. The parrot is a low-right focal point, so avoid placing a tall console or headboard there — keep that corner clear and centre furniture beneath the open water. Suited to a bedroom, kids' room or living room. Soft Matte flatters the painterly finish. Designed as a single scene scaled to your wall, not a repeat.

images.alt: Flamingo Tropical Paradise — Kids' play space

products.title: Tropical Ruins and Lotus
products.description: A tranquil colonial-era landscape where a pale manor house sits across a still lake, ringed by feathery palms, ferns and pink lotus-like blooms, with a red-and-blue bird perched at right and a long-billed bird gliding through the soft grey sky. Muted greens, misty blues and dusty pinks lend a calm, nostalgic mood. The open water and sky at centre keep it uncluttered, so furniture along the lower wall won't cover the house or birds, which sit high and to the sides. A refined choice for a bedroom, living room or foyer. Soft Matte complements its gentle painterly wash. composed as one continuous mural, never tiled.

products.title: Tropical Birds Waterfall Vista
products.description: A misty jungle vista opens onto a distant waterfall framed by towering palms, with a crimson bird in flight and two perched birds — one red-capped, one soft dove-grey — anchoring the right foreground, plus a coral bromeliad at lower left. Warm cream light glows through the haze against muted greens, giving a fresh yet serene feel. Detail concentrates on the right and edges while the airy centre stays open, so a bed or sofa placed centrally leaves the birds visible. Lovely in a bedroom, nursery or living room. Its atmospheric brushwork calls for Soft Matte. Each panel prints as one continuous scene, not a repeat.

products.title: Dense Tropical Fern Forest
products.description: A dense tropical valley unfolds in layers of palm fronds, broad banana leaves and feathery ferns, with misty blue hills receding behind and small red and yellow blooms tucked into the deep green foliage. The palette is lush emerald and jade against a soft cream sky, richly detailed and edge-to-edge busy in an illustrative botanical style. Greenery fills the full height, so the scene crops well on almost any wall while the misty gap at centre gives the eye room to rest; a sofa or bed sits comfortably against the leafy foreground. Great for living rooms, bedrooms, nurseries and kids' rooms. Soft Matte enhances the organic, layered leaves. Each mural prints as one continuous scene made to your wall's size, not a repeating pattern.

products.title: Tropical Jungle Panorama
products.description: A lush tropical jungle scene layered with banana fronds, palms and broad foliage in deep and sage greens, punctuated by a jewel-toned bird — blue head, orange breast — perched beside clusters of amber-orange blossoms. The mood is earthy and richly detailed, dense from edge to edge, with the bird and flowers sitting low-centre. Scaled to a wide wall the canopy extends naturally, though a headboard or sofa could obscure the bird, so keep the lower-centre band clear or centre furniture below it. Ideal for a bedroom, nursery or living room. Soft Matte suits its painterly canvas character. This is a single continuous mural, sized to your wall rather than repeated.
